name: s81_rly_38_wn-x1-COMMIT
purpose: S81-DV frame relay master dsfd_rly_38_WN (exact-width f_prog relay of the col_h9/col_h10 frames): real hard tile, 38 b in W / out N, ck+rs S, scalar ck/rs, M5 cap, one register stage, reset pin register, recipe 4 flop-first with die hold budget

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_rly_38_WN u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/frame/dsfd_rly_frame_exact.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_38_wn/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_38_wn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_38_wn --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_rly_38_WN  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-3F2-D3 10-17: new exact-width S81-DV frame relay (f_prog path, 7 per h9+h10 frame pair: col_h9 x3, col_h10 x4) replacing the dsfd_rly_63_WN instances c26l padded with 25 constant bits (owner 10-17 no-ties rule). Same body as the CLOSED dsfd_rly_63_WN r4 (ot_s81_rly RSREG=1, one register stage, reset pin register) and the same faces (i W / o N / ck+rs S); flow = the native-PASS successor form of the relay family (recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die, no outhold/inhold pads, as dsfd_rly_266_EW r4n / dsfd_dvrly_276). Outline 12.96 x 12.96 (smallest square on the 2.16 grid that gives >= 2 M5 PG stripes per net over > 50% of the outline at m5_pg_pitch 2.7; 10.8 fails pg_spread; 63_WN is 15.12).
